transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. Well, mostly it's because work sent me. I do maintenance, and... I guess I just keep forgetting things. 

Like, um... work orders. Scheduled callbacks. Just basic follow-ups I promised people I'd do. It kind of... piled up on me lately. They basically told me I needed to come here and get it sorted before I lose my shot at moving up. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you experience similar problems with attention and forgetfulness when you were growing up in school?

Yeah... um, I guess I've always been like this. Even back in grade school, long before this job. 

My teachers used to say I was bright, but... I don't know, I just always misplaced my papers. Or I'd miss parts of the directions. They always had to remind me to actually finish my work. So... yeah. It's not a new thing.
Aside from the frustration with work, how has your mood been—have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless?
Um... no, not really. Just... frustrated with work, like you said. I don't feel sad or anything. Just tired of messing up, I guess. But... no, not depressed or hopeless.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of everyday things, even when there is no clear reason to?
No. Not really. I just... I worry about my job, obviously. Because of the mistakes. But... no, not everything else. Just the normal stuff.
